versions.subject: Merge PR #4425 from @kidrek - ESXi Syslog Configuration Change Via ESXCLI
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '/esxcli'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'system'
        - 'syslog'
        - 'config'
    CommandLine|contains: ' set'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="*/esxcli" CommandLine="*system*" CommandLine="*syslog*" CommandLine="*config*" CommandLine="* set*"
